map.算例：训练年限与频率对硬度的影响: Worked example: effect of training years and frequency on hardness
map.：硬度指数=基础值+(上限-基础值)×年限系数×频率系数；年限系数[未训练0/1:
: hardness index = base + (upper − base) × years factor × frequency factor, with the years factor [untrained 0 / 1 year 0.6 / 2 years 0.8 / 3 years 1.0] and the frequency factor = min(1.5, 0.6 + sessions per week × 0.12).
Forearm (base 40 / upper 95): 3 years of training, twice a week → years factor 1.0, frequency factor 0.84 → hardness = round(40+55×1.0×0.84) = 86 (fairly hard, can take moderate force); untrained → 40 (weak); zero frequency → 73.
Chest (base 38 / upper 80): 3 years of training twice a week → round(38+42×0.84) = 73 (moderate).
⚠️ The head has a base of only 15 and an upper limit of 40, and strike training there carries extreme risk (possible brain damage), so the tool explicitly advises against it and shows a danger warning.

map.硬度指数怎么算？: How Is the Hardness Index Calculated?
map.硬度=基础值+(上限-基础值)×年限系数×频率系数。年限越长、训练越频繁，系数越: Hardness = base value + (upper limit − base value) × years factor × frequency factor. The longer and more frequent the training, the higher the factors and the harder the value; the base and upper values differ per part (forearm and knuckle are high, abdomen and chest lower).
map.头部为什么不建议练抗击打？: Why Is Head Striking Practice Not Advised?
map.头部抗击打极易造成脑震荡、脑损伤等不可逆伤害，远超出训练收益。本工具对头部给出明: Striking the head easily causes concussion and brain damage that is irreversible and far outweighs any training benefit. This tool gives an explicit danger warning for the head and advises against it — no hardness gain is worth risking brain health.
